subtopic: Hedge Funds vs. Registered Investment Funds
source_evidence: They are not subject to the numerous regulations that apply to mutual funds and ETFs for the protection of investors—including requiring that mutual fund shares be redeemable on a daily basis based on the net asset value (NAV)
question: Misconception: Hedge funds and registered mutual funds have the same investor protections, including daily share redemption.
answer: Correction: Hedge funds are not subject to many of the regulations that protect investors in mutual funds and ETFs. In particular, the source says the daily-redemption requirement applies to mutual fund shares; it does not say hedge funds have that same requirement.
